$comment: A self-contained planar multibond slice (C-MB1): inline Ground(world) -> 1-junction -> inline FixedTransform2D(a: world, b: arm) -> inline BodyPlanar(arm). The transform declares both frames on its ports and is the only bridge; the junction is frame-neutral (D-MB5).
name: PlanarArmMultibond

inline.source:
@block FixedTransform2D begin
    @ports begin
        a::Power{Planar}, [frame = "world"]
        b::Power{Planar}, [frame = "arm"]
    end
    @parameters begin
        x::Real = 0.0, [unit = "m", description = "Arm origin x in world"]
        y::Real = 0.3, [unit = "m", description = "Arm origin y in world"]
        theta::Real = 0.0, [unit = "rad", description = "Arm frame angle in world"]
    end
    @equations begin
        # g maps arm -> world. a.f = Ad(g) b.f and b.e = Ad(g)^T a.e, so the block is
        # power-continuous and is the only legal bridge from world to arm (D-MB5).
        a.f[1] ~ b.f[1]
        a.f[2] ~ -y * b.f[1] + cos(theta) * b.f[2] - sin(theta) * b.f[3]
        a.f[3] ~ x * b.f[1] + sin(theta) * b.f[2] + cos(theta) * b.f[3]
        b.e[1] ~ a.e[1] - y * a.e[2] + x * a.e[3]
        b.e[2] ~ cos(theta) * a.e[2] + sin(theta) * a.e[3]
        b.e[3] ~ -sin(theta) * a.e[2] + cos(theta) * a.e[3]
    end
end
